introSub: Our remedy is ready for manufacturing. Sort the vials through three quality control stations — confirm color, check for defects, and verify length. Only perfect vials reach mass distribution.
rackSub: Inspect all vials through three quality control stations. Sort defective vials before mass distribution.
distSub: These vials passed all quality checks. They are ready for mass distribution.
breakScript: Our team has done it. Thanks to your rigorous quality control, every vial sent to distribution is perfect — correct length, the right color, and free of defects. This medicine will now reach the people who need it most. Your work today is part of something much bigger: Pfizer's mission to deliver breakthroughs that change patients' lives.

stations.name: Color
stations.desc: Color sensor compares each vial against the reference sample to detect any color deviation.
stations.question: How does the color compare?

stations.name: Defects
stations.desc: X-ray scanner checks each vial for structural defects — cracks, chips, or fractures.
stations.question: What does the X-ray scan show?

stations.name: Length
stations.desc: Precision gauge verifies each vial is exactly 5 inches long.
stations.question: What does the length reading show?
